name: Nothing under the floor is ever applied
criteria: Across generated sets of ten to forty mornings from five to nine people, nothing under the floor is ever applied.
The refusal holds however tightly the reports agree, at every generated count.
The fit records what it examined even when it refuses, in every generated case.
acceptance: Twenty isolated runLearningFitOnce executions generate 10-40 zero-spread mornings from 5-9 reporters with a difference under sigma_eff/sqrt(n); every stored correction is present, reports its observed n/reporters and physical floor, and refuses. The assertion rejects a controlled applied:true mutation.
